issue_summary: My clothes still smell bad after every wash -- 2 self-service attempts tried, issue persists.
attempts_tried: Hi! To fix your clothes still smelling bad after every wash, please clean the lint filter (Section 3) — remove it, rinse thoroughly under running water, and reinsert firmly. Let us know if this helps!

Hi! To fix your clothes still smelling bad after every wash, please run a descaling cycle (Section 3) if the filter was already clean or the smell persists. This clears mineral buildup a regular filter clean alone won’t fix. Let us know if this helps!
